fields.Brand Positioning: Radisson Inn & Suites is an upper-midscale, select-service brand delivering heartfelt hospitality in a modern setting—naturally grounded design that helps guests feel welcome, valued, and connected to the destination.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Inviting real connections through café-inspired lobbies, elevated breakfast, thoughtful guestrooms, and local character—so business and leisure travelers feel at home while exploring the destination.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Heartfelt experience via inviting design, café lobby social spaces, elevated coffee and breakfast, residential guestroom touches, and content-studio flex space introduced in 2022.

Owners: Upper-midscale select-service in metro, airport, and mixed-use communities; distinctive exterior architecture signaling the brand.

Franchise system: Part of Choice's Radisson Americas portfolio with global loyalty and distribution.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Naturally Grounded — wood grains, plants, natural materials, indoor/outdoor connection.

Community Centered — café lobby, makers' market pop-ups, social seating.

Heartfelt Hospitality — guests feel welcome, valued, and looked after.
fields.Brand History: Launched March 2022 as an upper-midscale select-service brand within Choice's Radisson Americas portfolio, expanding the Radisson family in North America after Choice's acquisition of the Radisson Americas business.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Travelers who mix business and pleasure, seek convenience and comfort, and value real connections with staff, fellow guests, and local culture—memorable moments over generic chain stays.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Inviting Real Connections brand essence with Modern Comfort selling line.

Café-inspired 24-hour lobby with elevated breakfast and private call pods.

Content creation studio for influencers and remote work overflow.

Contemporary exteriors and guestrooms designed for Zoom-friendly layouts.
fields.Sustainability Positioning: Design emphasizes natural light, biophilic materials, and indoor/outdoor spaces; supports Choice Hotels' Room to be Green® and ESG standards.
